title: 'Stage all models on connect' is live in Settings with no RunPod API key saved
description:
MERGED INTO MPI-404 on 2026-08-01 - closed as rejected: not built, folded into the host card, kept here as the record. Original text follows.

Spotted by the user 2026-07-30 on the real 1.3.0 portable extract, Settings -> RunPod, no API key entered. The ACCOUNT panel above it states the rule plainly - 'To unlock the RunPod controls, save a RunPod API key with read + write access in the box below' - and 'Stage all models on connect' sits below that line, fully interactive, with the key box still empty and reading 'No API key saved'.

The toggle only has meaning on connect, and connect is impossible without a key, so it is a control the user can set that cannot do anything yet. Low severity - nothing breaks, the setting simply persists until it becomes relevant. It is a coherence bug in the settings panel, not a functional one: the panel promises the controls are locked and then shows an unlocked one.

'Skip the local engine install' directly above it is a DIFFERENT case and must stay ungated - it governs whether the app provisions a local engine at all, which is a decision a user makes precisely when they have no key yet. Do not sweep both in one change.

Check the rest of the RunPod section for the same shape before fixing, and decide whether the pattern is disable-until-key or hide-until-key - whichever the other gated controls in that panel already use, so this does not introduce a third convention.

HARDENED 2026-07-31 after the user re-raised it. The skip-install carve-out above is now VERIFIED IN CODE, not just asserted - do not undo it. _applyEnabled (MpiRunpodSettings.js:1568-1578) hides exactly three things when no key is saved: #mpiSettingsRunpodBody, #mpiSettingsRunpodAutoConnectGroup, #mpiSettingsRunpodAutoRetryGroup. The Skip-the-local-engine-install plate sits between the auto-connect and auto-retry plates (template ~line 65) with NO id, and #mpiSettingsRunpodBody does not open until line 89, so the plate is outside every gated region. It is ungated BY CONSTRUCTION, and that is correct. WHY IT CAN NEVER BE GATED: the escape hatch on the install modal is the only way IN to skipLocalEngine, and this Settings switch is the only way OUT - there is no engine-install section in Settings (storage.js:62-69 states this and calls the toggle the thing that stops the hatch being a one-way door). Gate the switch behind the API key and a GPU-less user with no key who pressed Skip Install can never reach a local engine again. So the fix for THIS card is scoped to Stage-all-models-on-connect only; adding an id to the skip plate or moving it inside the body is a REGRESSION, not a tidy-up.

SECOND ITEM - RAISED AND CLOSED 2026-07-31, NO CHANGE. Briefly considered making the Settings switch off-only so the escape hatch was the sole way to turn skipLocalEngine ON. The user confirmed the CURRENT two-way behaviour is what they want: off by default, turned on either by the Settings switch or by the escape hatch on the install modal, and turning it off re-arms the install prompt. Verified this is already how it works, and better than assumed - flipping the switch off emits engine:install-request so the modal appears IMMEDIATELY rather than at next boot (MpiRunpodSettings.js:1627-1635), and engine:install-skipped syncs the switch back ON if the user then presses the hatch on that modal. Nothing to build.
acceptance: 'Stage all models on connect' is not settable until a RunPod API key is saved, matching whatever convention the other gated RunPod controls already use
'Skip the local engine install' stays ungated - it is a pre-key decision by design
The rest of the RunPod settings section is swept for the same ungated-below-a-lock-message shape in the same pass
